content.json:
## Tools
How agents use secsdk tools: volume, failures, latency, what they ask for, and which upstream APIs are slow. Argument views need content capture (30-day retention).

content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Message == "agw.tool_arguments"
| extend tool = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.name"]), arguments = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.call.arguments"]),
         user = tostring(Properties["agw.user.id"]), session = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.conversation.id"]),
         agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]), run = tostring(Properties["agw.run_id"])
| where isnotempty("{Search}") and arguments contains "{Search}"
| project TimeGenerated, tool, arguments, agent, user, session, run
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Tool calls whose arguments match the search
content.noDataMessage: Type a value in Search (for example a CVE id).

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name startswith "execute_tool "
| extend tool = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.name"]), agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]),
         outcome = tostring(Properties["agw.tool.outcome"]) | summarize calls = count() by tool, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Tool calls over time

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name startswith "execute_tool "
| extend tool = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.name"]), agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]),
         outcome = tostring(Properties["agw.tool.outcome"])
| summarize calls = count(), failed = countif(isnotempty(outcome) and outcome != "ok"), p50_ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50)),
            p95_ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)), agents = make_set(agent) by tool
| extend failure_pct = round(100.0 * failed / calls, 1)
| order by calls desc
content.title: Per tool: volume, failures and latency

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name startswith "execute_tool "
| extend tool = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.name"]), agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]),
         outcome = tostring(Properties["agw.tool.outcome"]) | where isnotempty(outcome) and outcome != "ok" | summarize failures = count() by tool, outcome | order by failures desc
content.title: Failures by tool and error code

content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Message == "agw.tool_arguments"
| extend tool = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.name"]), arguments = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.call.arguments"]),
         user = tostring(Properties["agw.user.id"]), session = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.conversation.id"]),
         agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]), run = tostring(Properties["agw.run_id"])
| extend cve = extract_all(@"(CVE-\d{4}-\d{4,7})", toupper(arguments))
| mv-expand cve to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(cve)
| summarize lookups = count(), users = dcount(user), tools = make_set(tool), last_seen = max(TimeGenerated) by cve
| order by lookups desc
| take 50
content.title: Most-queried CVEs

content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Message == "agw.tool_arguments"
| extend tool = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.name"]), arguments = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.call.arguments"]),
         user = tostring(Properties["agw.user.id"]), session = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.conversation.id"]),
         agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]), run = tostring(Properties["agw.run_id"])
| extend bag = parse_json(arguments)
| mv-expand kind = array kv = bag
| extend param = tostring(kv[0]), value = tostring(kv[1])
| where value != "[redacted]"
| summarize calls = count() by tool, param, value
| order by calls desc
| take 100
content.title: Top argument values per tool

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName == "agent-gateway-runtime" and DependencyType !in ("InProc", "") and Name !startswith "POST "
| summarize calls = count(), errors = countif(Success == false), p95_ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)),
            retries = sum(toint(Properties["http.request.resend_count"])) by host = Target
| order by calls desc
content.title: Upstream APIs called by tools (secsdk HTTP)
